config_lead: Every setting the AI Detector understands, where it goes in the JSON and what it does. For everyone who wants to fine-tune beyond the presets.
config_where_title: Where do you change these settings?
config_where_app: In the app: Settings → Advanced. The Detection document is your config.json; AI connections holds your AI providers. The app checks the JSON before it saves, and monitoring restarts by itself.
config_where_file: In the file: config.json in the data folder (paths below). Pause monitoring or close AI Detector first, and keep a copy of the file.
config_where_preset: Good to know: as soon as you change detection settings (model, confidence, cooldown…), the detector becomes a custom detector and no longer receives newer models from its preset. Choose the preset again in the detector editor to follow it once more.
config_backup: Make a backup first under Settings → Back up. It contains camera passwords and tokens, so keep it safe.
config_structure_text: Click a key to jump to its explanation. Everything for one detector sits inside one object in the detectors list; onnx and health sit at the top level.
config_search_placeholder: For example cooldown, quiet or confidence
config_classes_text: Use these names in a confidence or cooldown map. A class the model does not know is never detected.
config_recipes_text: Copy the part you need and put it in the right place in your detector.
config_mistakes_text: The app refuses to save JSON it cannot read and tells you what is wrong. These are the usual suspects.
config_presets_text: A preset is a detector file without cameras: model, classes, event rules and delivery defaults. Put your own JSON files in a presets folder next to config.json and reload the detector editor: they replace the built-in list, so copy the built-in files in to keep them. Detectors that follow a preset check once a day for a newer version. In app.json, autoUpdate: false stops that for one detector and mode (such as low-power) says which mode it follows.
config_in_english: The explanations on this page are shown in English.
config_tutorials_text: The tutorials show the Advanced page in action: a longer cooldown for the calf and a heartbeat with Healthchecks.io.
